verdict.rationale: Codegen docs show PR review capability (reads diff, summarizes changes, runs security/secrets scan, checks test coverage, posts review comment on failure) and general 'review PRs, suggest changes, comment on issues' agent skills, plus SDK examples of triggering a review via agent.run. However, evidence doesn't confirm this runs automatically on every PR as a gating check, inline line-level comments, or independent/hands-on confirmation of reliability. missing for 10: automatic trigger-on-every-PR configuration details, inline (line-by-line) comment placement evidence, independent/hands-on validation of review quality and consistency.
